predecessors.name: Khazar Khaganate (Khazaria)
predecessors.text: the plain and foothills of the North Caucasus from the Laba to the Argun, up to the Darial Gorge

successors.name: Mongol Empire
successors.text: the plain and foothills of the North Caucasus from the Laba to the Argun, up to the Darial Gorge

capitals.name: Maghas (site disputed; Arkhyz is one proposal)

ledger.x: Late 9th century: Alania frees itself from the Khazars.

wars.name: Mongol invasion of Alania
wars.outcome: The Mongols under Batu stormed and destroyed Maghas; the siege ran from late 1239 to February 1240; most Alans submitted to the Mongol Empire in 1239-1277.

certainty.note: Only the river limits (Laba, Argun, Darial Gorge) are given; the capital's site is itself disputed.
